0022600205.text: The Washington Wizards (4-6, 2nd in the Southeast and 8th in the East) visit the Detroit Pistons (6-2, 1st in the Central) on a three-game losing streak, while Detroit enters on a one-game skid. Washington is without Jamir Watkins, Justin Champagnie, Reece Beekman, and Tristan Vukcevic, and Anthony Davis and Deandre Ayton are day-to-day with ankle and leg injuries, respectively, and are game-time decisions; Detroit is missing Isaiah Joe and Jalen Duren. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Wizards lost the series 1-3, including a 117-95 loss in Washington on March 19, 2026.
